CLI: exactly six positional ints k,r,x,a,b,d, no defaults
constructor: per group A=X+H,B=X+P,C=X; one D=P+V; unit customer multiplicities
target_membership: target count in s.outcomes(), not prescribed ordered path
negative_only_output: path_thresholds rows [current count, str(true BI threshold), str(current action payoff in final target)] along C_i then rD
stats_meaning: snapshot of cached state count, terminal state count and sum of per-state retained outcome-set sizes; not strategy count
elapsed: after solver/instance/target construction to creation of initial output, before negative path diagnostics
output: one JSON stdout line flush only; no strategy or file write
